name: Sand — Crushed White Quartz

behavior.reason: In the vibrating-plate regime the time-averaged force on a granule is directed toward displacement nodes (minima of amplitude). Lighter particles move faster.
behavior.pattern_clarity: best between 100-2000 Hz at amplitudes 0.1-1 mm

notes: Fine quartz gives best resolution. Coarser sand shows mode shapes at lower frequencies. Lycopodium powder (see media/lycopodium.json) shows finer features.
